name: gralloch
description: Isolation-first reverse-engineering pipeline for Windows PE. A native Rust MCP server (gralloch-mcp) does the fast deterministic work (triage, safe case creation); Ghidra/capa/Frida are orchestrated externally. See tz-re-pipeline.md.

cases_root.title: Cases root
cases_root.description: Directory for analysis cases, OUTSIDE the plugin. Each case gets its own subfolder. Used as the default when a tool is not given an explicit cases root.

capa_exe.title: capa executable
capa_exe.description: Path to the standalone capa.exe (bundles rules + signatures). Enables capa enrichment (/capa). Leave empty to use capa on PATH.

upx_exe.title: upx executable
upx_exe.description: Path to upx.exe. Enables static UPX unpacking (/unpack). Leave empty to use upx on PATH.

ghidra_install_dir.title: Ghidra install dir
ghidra_install_dir.description: Ghidra installation directory (GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR). Enables headless static export (/static).
